newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil turns clocks back one hour Saturday Feb 15.
newsitem.headline: Brazil turns clocks back one hour Saturday Feb 15.

text.p: Brazil ends its Daylight Savings Time schedule at midnight Saturday Feb 15 and will turn its clocks back by one hour, officials said.
As of 0000 local Sunday Feb 16 Brasilia, Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro will be three hours behind Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) and two hours ahead of Eastern Standard Time (EST).
Officials said the Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro stock exchanges would continue to function within the time schedule currently in place.
